items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...where we used to interview Mr. Albert and Vess and other people were here the last time I was here.

ctx.x: This is Bill Russell speaking. We're interviewing Mr. Milton Martin. Is that your full name? Over at Tom Albert's house on Burgundy Street, where we used to interview Mr. Albert and Vess and other people were here the last time I was here. Can you give us your full name? Everybody calls you Mooney.
